camel_example: aliyun rds DescribeBackups --region cn-hangzhou --EndTime '2011-06-15T16:00Z' --PageSize 30 --DBInstanceId 'rm-uf6wjk50000' --PageNumber 1 --BackupMode Automated --StartTime '2011-06-01T16:00Z' --BackupId 327329803 --BackupType FullBackup --BackupStatus Success
description_en: This API is used to view the backup set list of an RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查看RDS实例的备份集列表
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-backups --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --backup-id 327329803 --backup-status Success --backup-mode Automated --start-time 2011-06-01T16:00Z --end-time 2011-06-15T16:00Z --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --backup-type FullBackup --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBackups

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup set
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the backup set. Valid values:

Success
Failed
parameters.help_zh:
备份集状态。取值：
Success：已完成备份
Failed：备份失败
parameters.name: backup_status

parameters.help_en:
The backup mode. Valid values:

Automated
Manual
parameters.help_zh:
备份模式，取值：
Automated：系统自动备份
Manual：手动备份
parameters.name: backup_mode

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

We recommend that you specify a time range that is as short as possible to avoid timeout
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，需要大于查询开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 建议您在使用本接口查询备份集列表信息时，将查询开始和结束的时间段缩小一些，如果时间段较长可能出现超时问题
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

30
50
100

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：
30
50
100

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The number of the page to return. Valid values: any non-zero positive integer.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The backup type. Valid values:

FullBackup: full backup
IncrementalBackup: incremental backup
parameters.help_zh:
备份类型，取值：
FullBackup：全量备份
IncrementalBackup：增量备份
parameters.name: backup_type

items.description_en: The details of the returned backup sets

BackupDownloadLinkByDB.description_en: An array consisting of URLs from which you can download backup sets of individual databases
BackupDownloadLinkByDB.description_zh:
单库备份下载链接列表。

云盘实例不返回该参数

items.description_zh: 单库备份下载链接详情

DownloadLink.description_en: The public URL from which you can download the backup set

IntranetDownloadLink.description_en: The internal URL from which you can download the backup set

BackupDownloadURL.description_en:
The URL that is used to download the backup set over the Internet. If the backup set cannot be downloaded, null is returned.

For example, if BackupMethod of an ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance is set to Snapshot, a null string is returned
BackupDownloadURL.description_zh:
公网下载地址，若当前不可下载，则返回空值。

例如：备份方式为快照备份的SQL Server实例会返回空值。

云盘实例不返回该参数

BackupEndTime.description_en: The end time of the backup task. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
BackupEndTime.description_zh: 本次备份结束时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）

BackupId.description_en: The ID of the backup set

BackupInitiator.description_en:
The initiator of the backup task. Valid values:

System
User
BackupInitiator.description_zh:
备份任务的发起者。返回值：
System：系统自动发起。
User：用户手动发起

BackupIntranetDownloadURL.description_en:
The URL that is used to download the backup set over an internal network. If the backup set cannot be downloaded, null is returned.

For example, if BackupMethod of an ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance is set to Snapshot, a null string is returned
BackupIntranetDownloadURL.description_zh:
内网下载地址，若当前不可下载，则返回空值。

例如：备份方式为快照备份的SQL Server实例会返回空值。

云盘实例不返回该参数

BackupMethod.description_en:
The method that is used to generate the backup set. Valid values:

Logical: logical backup
Physical: physical backup
Snapshot: snapshot backup
BackupMethod.description_zh:
备份方式，返回值：
Logical：逻辑备份
Physical：物理备份
Snapshot：快照备份

BackupMode.description_en:
The backup mode of the backup set. Valid values:

Automated
Manual
BackupMode.description_zh:
备份模式，返回值：
Automated：系统自动备份
Manual：手动备份

BackupSize.description_en: The size of the data backup file. Unit: bytes

BackupStartTime.description_en: The start time of the backup. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
BackupStartTime.description_zh: 本次备份开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）

BackupStatus.description_en: The state of the backup set

BackupType.description_en:
The backup type of the backup set. Valid values:

FullBackup
IncrementalBackup
BackupType.description_zh:
备份类型，返回值：
FullBackup：全量备份
IncrementalBackup：增量备份

Checksum.description_en: The checksum. The value of this parameter is calculated by using the CRC64 algorithm

ConsistentTime.description_en:
The point in time at which the data in the backup set is consistent. The return value of this parameter is a timestamp.

If the instance runs MySQL 5.6, a timestamp is returned. Otherwise, the value 0 is returned
ConsistentTime.description_zh:
备份集的一致性时间点。返回值为时间戳。
仅MySQL 5.6返回本参数，其他版本返回0

CopyOnlyBackup.description_en:
The backup mode of the backup set. Valid values:

0: the standard mode. This mode supports full backups and incremental backups.
1: the copy-only mode. This mode supports only full backups.

This parameter is returned only when the instance runs SQL Server
CopyOnlyBackup.description_zh:
SQL Server实例备份模式，分为常规备份模式（支持全量和增量恢复）和仅复制模式（仅支持全量恢复），返回值：
0：常规备份模式
1：仅复制模式

Encryption.description_en: The encryption information about the backup set

Engine.description_en:
The type of the database engine. Valid values:

MySQL
SQLServer
PostgreSQL
MariaDB
Engine.description_zh:
数据库类型。返回值：
MySQL
SQLServer
PostgreSQL
MariaDB

EngineVersion.description_en: The version of the database engine

ExpectExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the backup set, in the format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC time). This value is returned only for single-database backups of SQL Server instances when backup retention days is configured.
ExpectExpireTime.description_zh: 备份集过期时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC 时间）。 仅SQL Server单库备份设置备份集保留天数后返回该值

HostInstanceID.description_en: The ID of the instance that generates the backup set. This parameter is used to indicate whether the instance that generates the backup set is a primary instance or a secondary instance
HostInstanceID.description_zh: 产生备份集的实例编号，用于区分该备份集产生于主实例或备实例

IsAvail.description_en:
Indicates whether the backup set is available. Valid values:

0: The backup set is unavailable.
1: The backup set is available
IsAvail.description_zh:
备份集是否可用，返回值：
0：不可用
1：可用

MetaStatus.description_en:
The status of the backup set that is used to restore individual databases or tables. Valid values:

OK: The data backup file is normal.
LARGE: The data backup file contains an abnormally large number of tables. It cannot be used to restore individual databases or tables.
EMPTY: The data backup file is generated from a failed backup task.

If an empty string is returned, the data backup file cannot be used to restore individual databases or tables
MetaStatus.description_zh:
库表恢复的备份集状态，返回值：
OK：正常。
LARGE：表数量过多，不能用于库表恢复。
EMPTY：备份失败的备份集。

空串表示未开通库表恢复的备份集

StorageClass.description_en:
The storage class of the backup set. Valid values:

0: regular storage
1: archive storage
StorageClass.description_zh:
备份集的存储介质，返回值：
0：常规存储
1：归档存储

StoreStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the backup set can be deleted. Valid values:

Enabled: The backup set can be deleted.
Disabled: The backup set cannot be deleted
StoreStatus.description_zh:
该数据备份是否可删除，返回值：
Enabled：可删除
Disabled：不可删除

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of backup sets on the current page

TotalEcsSnapshotSize.description_en: The size of the snapshot chain of the instance. Unit: bytes
TotalEcsSnapshotSize.description_zh: 实例的快照链大小，单位：字节（Byte）

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
